frame.description: z up; W1 (sink wall, backsplash tile face) is y=0, room y>0; W2 (right wall, backsplash tile face) is x=0, room x>0; origin = inside corner at floor level. Units inches (mm also given). Drywall is ~0.4in behind the tile face.

countertop_top_height_above_floor.method: z of RANSAC/median countertop plane (1650 sparse pts) minus floor z (17 sparse floor pts)

left_run_countertop_front_edge_y.method: 05 top-arris pixels (4 pts, both sides of sink) ray-intersected with countertop top plane

left_run_countertop_thickness.method: 05 front-edge bottom pixels ray-intersected with the counter front plane; top plane minus bottom

right_run_countertop_front_edge_x.method: 04 top-arris pixels ray-intersected with countertop top plane

right_run_countertop_thickness.method: 04 front-edge bottom pixels ray-intersected with the counter front plane

right_run_countertop_end_y (run length f.method: front-top-right counter corner: 2-view triangulation (04,03; reproj [5.  6.5] px) + 2 ray/top-plane estimates

left_run_upper_door_face_y (depth from W.method: mean y of 3 multi-view Manhattan line fits on the 30in upper over sink

right_run_upper_door_face_x (depth from.method: x of 3-view Manhattan line fit of right-run upper bottom front edge

right_run_upper_bottom_height.method: 3-view (04,03,02) Manhattan y-line fit, rms 1.3px; loo z spread 0.006 units

left_run_tall_upper_right_of_sink_bottom.method: rays from 05 (2 px) and 02 (2 px) intersected with left upper face plane

left_run_tall_upper_left_of_sink_bottom_.method: 05 rays intersected with left upper face plane (single view)

left_run_corner_upper_bottom_height.method: 05 rays intersected with left upper face plane (single view)

short_upper_bottom_minus_tall_upper_bott.method: difference of the two above (scale-dependent only)

left_run_crown_underside_height (top of.method: mean of 2-view (05,03) and 3-view (05,03,02) Manhattan x-line fits (97.0 / 97.3 in)

left_run_crown_top_height.method: mean of 2-view (05,03) and 3-view (05,03,02) Manhattan x-line fits (100.4 / 100.8 in)

pantry_cap_top_height.method: 2-view (05,03) Manhattan x-line fit, rms 1.4px; edge y=29.0in from W1 (cap projects past pantry face)

pantry_cap_underside_height.method: 2-view (05,03) Manhattan x-line fit, rms 1.3px; edge y=26.8in from W1 (cap projects past pantry face)

right_run_base_door_face_x (depth from W.method: 3-view Manhattan vertical-line fit of right-run door-base left edge

right_run_door_base_to_drawer_stack_seam.method: 04 rays at seam gap centre on base face plane

right_run_drawer_stack_right_end_y.method: 04 rays at stack right edge on base face plane

right_run_upper_cab1_left_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab1_right_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab2_left_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab2_door_meet_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab2_right_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab3_left_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab3_door_meet_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab3_right_end_y.method: 04 ray (row 1300) on right upper face plane

right_run_upper_cab1_single_door_width.method: difference of 04 edge rays on face plane

right_run_upper_cab2_double_door_width.method: difference of 04 edge rays on face plane

right_run_upper_cab3_double_door_width.method: difference of 04 edge rays on face plane

left_run_base_door_face_y (depth from W1.method: mean y of 2 multi-view vertical-line fits (sink-base left gap, 3-drawer left gap)

left_run_pantry_left_edge_x.method: 05 rays on face plane / multi-view line fits

left_run_pantry_right_edge_x.method: 05 rays on face plane / multi-view line fits
